items.html: *Know that there are four phases in the world of Atzilut, in how the male and female are situated there, whether they are in phases of dots prior to the correction, or when they are in the phase of a complete Partzuf after the correction. This is their arrangement: The worst is when both are back-to-back. Above it is back-to-face. This means that the male turns his posterior facing the anterior of the female, as now the female can receive the light from the posterior of the male, through her anterior. However, she still does not have the strength to receive from the anterior of the male. Above it, it is face-to-back. This means that the male turns his anterior facing the posterior of the female and shines in her. There is greater merit in that since the light of the anterior of the male itself shines in the female, although she still does not have the strength to receive it through the anterior. For this reason, she turns her posterior and receives the light in the anterior themselves through there. By so doing, the light becomes a little coarser there, and when the light passes through the posterior and reaches the side of her anterior, she will be able to receive it, since it became a little coarser. This is the meaning of, “A wise will improve her in the back.” When the anterior of the Hochma, which is the male, look in the posterior of the female and shine in her, it will give her merit and shine in her an additional illumination, more than if they were the opposite, which is the posterior in the anterior, which is the second degree.
